name: EEG and event-related potentials (ERP): windows into brain activity
description: End-of-studies individual project (poster) on electroencephalography and event-related potentials. Covers the neural basis of EEG signals, ERP analysis methods, and a review of automatic vigilance-state classification (alert, drowsy, sleep) using discrete wavelet transform and a feedforward neural network (Kiymik et al., 2004), reporting about 94-96% accuracy.
